People: James Tytler (author, Wikidata Q504979), died 1804. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Tytler, James, 1745-1804") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: A treatise on the plague and yellow fever.  1799, 1799, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bim_eighteenth-century_a-treatise-on-the-plague_tytler-james-ma-of-_1799. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 100%, 58%, 68% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of James Tytler, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
